title: Longest Harmonious Subsequence
summary: Given an integer array nums, find the length of the longest subsequence where the difference between the maximum and minimum values in the subsequence is exactly 1.
statement: Given an integer array nums, find the length of the longest subsequence where the difference between the maximum and minimum values in the subsequence is exactly 1.
constraints: A valid subsequence has maximum minus minimum exactly one.
hints: Only two neighboring values can appear in a harmonious subsequence.
Count every value, then combine each count with value+1.
Build a frequency map and maximize count[x]+count[x+1].
All copies of two adjacent values help, while any farther value would violate the exact range requirement.
editorial: All copies of two adjacent values help, while any farther value would violate the exact range requirement.
